scenarios.name: Hide and restore a panel from the minimized ribbon

scenario_steps.name: the top-docked ribbon is minimized to tabs with 3D Model active
the Simulation panel is enabled for 3D Model
the user right-clicks the 3D Model tab
Simulation is checked in the panel list
the menus close and the ribbon remains minimized to tabs
the user clicks the 3D Model tab
the temporary ribbon opens without a Simulation panel
the user right-clicks the 3D Model tab
the menus and temporary ribbon close
the user double-clicks the 3D Model tab
the full ribbon is visible with the Simulation panel
